declared_claims.text: The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.
A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.
A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel.
Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.
Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.
Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate.
Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.

parsed_response.narration: Rain spatters against the soot-dark stones as frayed banners flap weakly above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. The muddy approach is choked with refugees, wagons, and foot traffic, pressing against the guards who hold firm in tight formation. Near the gate, a gate serjeant keeps a watchful eye on the crowds while frequently glancing toward a nearby notice board. The board itself lists grim new taxes, curfew regulations, and a posted warning about a patrol that has gone missing. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster uneasily along the gate line, their gazes flickering between the gate, the crowd, and the bustling tavern runner shouting offers of hot stew and snippets of rumor beside a rain barrel. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the caravan's eastern choke point, adding strain to the already sluggish movement through the gate district.
